text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Phew... This is great! If I can keep this<n>up—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hayahideee!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ticket!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: You looked amazing in today's race!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I was chasing after you as hard as I<n>could, but I
couldn't even get close!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Gosh! You're just way too... good...Sniffle...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ticket...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I might've lost this time, but I'll get<n>you next time!
Waaah!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'll have to try my hardest not<n>to lose, then.
Let's both keep doing<n>our best.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After the race, I'm in the middle of<n>preparing ice
packs for Biwa<n>Hayahide when I hear her behind
me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well? How did I do today?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I agree. I feel so much stronger after<n>summer—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: N-nothing. I'm fine. Absolutely<n>everything is all right.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm just so happy...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I wanted to win this race so<n>badly, and my legs
didn't let me<n>down.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It was nothing like how they failed me<n>before, just
when I needed to run a<n>little faster...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yeah. That's all...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I wonder if I can catch up to her now...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hm... You're right.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That's exactly why we've been<n>working so hard
on my winning<n>equation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: So I can finally beat Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
There are two more months until the<n>Arima Kinen.
Only a short while<n>remains until it's time for the
long-awaited sibling showdown.
